skull-post rotation (walkthroughs 345/488): Thraxia 8am-4pm, Terje 4pm-midnight, Lord Lauur midnight-8am; each is an HourWindowSpawn (its hours by name, HourWindows), so one of the three stands at the post at any hour, as the step texts say (verify fix 2026-11-11: the first version used day/night spawns, 6-18 and 18-6, and the HourWindowSpawn written for this was unused)

set.StepText: Find the first sister, Jodis Rindasdottir.|Slay the werewolf shaman and take the sword hilt.|Return the hilt to Jodis.|Find the second sister in Yggdra Forest.|Recover the sister's drawings from a wyvern.|Recover her book from a bone-eater spine ripper.|Bring Edonia her drawings and book.|Give the book and drawings to Coplin's spirit.|Find the third sister, Norma, in Vanern Swamp; she needs a new water skin made from a battle scarred mauler's bladder, so slay one.|Give Norma the new water skin.|Have the smith in Vasudheim forge the sword.|Return the sword to Anrid.|Choose your reward: whisper Anrid the name of the item you want (Runic Staff of the Sisters, Suppressing Staff of the Sisters, Suppressive Staff of the Sisters).

entries.why: The Three Sisters steps 9/10 read 'Bring Norma a new water skin...' before 'Find the third sister, Norma'; period walkthrough 1768 meets Norma in Vanern Swamp first. Journal texts reworded to the period order (no dialogue changed)
